model: A reversible two-state monomer model at one temperature:DeltaG_unfold(c)=DeltaG0-m*c,and unfolded fraction u(c)=1/(1+exp(DeltaG_unfold/RT)). Observed fluorescence F(c)=(1-u)*F_N(c)+u*F_U(c). Both baseline functions are independently calibrated and hold on the listed range. Measurements are exact means;no third state,irreversibility or concentration-dependent association is included. Neither finite endpoint is declared a pure state.
target: Infer DeltaG0in kJ/mol and min kJ/mol/M,return the denaturant midpoint where u=1/2,and native fraction at1M. Also report the naive unfolded fraction at1Mcomputed as(F(1)-10)/(30-10),and whether that naive normalization equals the model unfolded fraction there. Do not fit a logistic directly to raw fluorescence without handling the calibrated baselines.

provenance.kind: Explicit synthetic benign biological measurement model with exact source observations;not an empirical validation or sequence-design recommendation.
